cname.description: It is the target of the host name's first CNAME. null when the host name has none.

chain.description: It lists every target of the CNAME chain in order, cname first. The check judges the last name. [] without a CNAME.

target_exists.description: Whether the last name of chain exists. null without a CNAME.

dangling.description: true when the host name has a CNAME and the last name of chain does not exist.

provider.description: The service whose name suffix ends the last name of chain. null when the check knows no such suffix.

takeover_possible.description: false without a CNAME. With a provider, true when dangling is true and false otherwise. null when the host name has a CNAME and provider is null, even when the last name exists. DNS alone cannot tell then.

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.
